tests.name: Rig: Locate an actual Stardock shipyard

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.sector_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: Move and dock shipyard tester

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{shipyard_sector_id} WHERE name = 'shipyard_tester';

tests.name: Rig: Move active ship and dock at Stardock

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{shipyard_sector_id}, ported = (SELECT p.port_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt ON pt.porttype_id = p.porttype_id WHERE p.sector_id = @{shipyard_sector_id} AND pt.is_stardock = TRUE ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1) WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'shipyard_tester');
